title: Pardons Andrew Barron Worden
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Andrew Barron Worden as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: Donald Trump’s clemency list includes Andrew Barron Worden, whose case was in the Southern District of New York. The Justice Department records a conviction for wire fraud and a sentence of two years’ probation, conditioned on community service and continued payment owed to the SEC. The list does not describe the conduct behind the conviction or explain the pardon.

preserved_fields.title: Pardons Andrew Barron Worden
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Andrew Barron Worden as part of a clemency list.

notes: The DOJ clemency list identifies Worden’s Southern District of New York wire-fraud conviction and two-year probation sentence with community service and continued SEC payments. It does not describe the underlying conduct or state a rationale for clemency.

title: Pardons Jesse R. Benton
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Jesse R. Benton as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: Donald Trump’s clemency list includes Jesse R. Benton, convicted in the Southern District of Iowa. The Justice Department lists conspiracy against the United States, false records and campaign-contribution reports, and a false-statements scheme. Benton received two years’ probation, six months’ home confinement, community service, and a $10,000 fine; the list does not describe the scheme or explain the pardon.

preserved_fields.title: Pardons Jesse R. Benton
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Jesse R. Benton as part of a clemency list.

notes: The DOJ list identifies Benton’s Southern District of Iowa offenses and sentence: two years’ probation, six months’ home confinement, 160 hours of community service, and a $10,000 fine. It does not explain the underlying conduct, Benton’s role, or a reason for clemency.

title: Pardons Susan B. Anthony
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Susan B. Anthony as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: Donald Trump issued a posthumous pardon for suffragist Susan B. Anthony in 2020. The Justice Department’s list records her 1873 conviction in the Northern District of New York for illegal voting and a $100 fine plus prosecution costs. The entry confirms the historical conviction and pardon, but does not state the administration’s reason or explain the intended significance of the gesture.

preserved_fields.title: Pardons Susan B. Anthony
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Susan B. Anthony as part of a clemency list.

notes: The DOJ list records Anthony’s 1873 Northern District of New York illegal-voting conviction and $100 fine plus prosecution costs. It confirms Trump’s posthumous pardon but does not document the administration’s purpose or explain the symbolic context.
